```sql
WITH managerial_employees AS (
    SELECT 
        e.first_name, 
        e.last_name, 
        dm.dept_no
    FROM 
        dept_manager dm 
    JOIN 
        employees e ON e.emp_no = dm.emp_no
),
reporting_employees AS (
    SELECT 
        de.emp_no,
        dm.dept_no
    FROM 
        dept_emp de 
    JOIN 
        dept_manager dm ON de.dept_no = dm.dept_no 
    WHERE 
        de.from_date < dm.to_date 
        AND dm.from_date < de.to_date 
        AND de.emp_no <> dm.emp_no
)
SELECT 
    CONCAT(me.first_name, ' ', me.last_name) AS manager_name, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT re.emp_no) AS reporting_employees 
FROM 
    managerial_employees me 
LEFT JOIN 
    reporting_employees re ON me.dept_no = re.dept_no 
GROUP BY 
    me.first_name, me.last_name 
ORDER BY 
    reporting_employees DESC, manager_name ASC, me.emp_no ASC 
LIMIT 10;
```

```sql
WITH manager_employees AS (
    SELECT 
        e.emp_no AS manager_emp_no,
        CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name) AS manager_name,
        de.emp_no AS reporting_emp_no
    FROM 
        dept_manager dm 
    JOIN 
        employees e ON e.emp_no = dm.emp_no 
    LEFT JOIN 
        dept_emp de ON de.dept_no = dm.dept_no 
        AND de.from_date < dm.to_date 
        AND dm.from_date < de.to_date 
        AND de.emp_no <> dm.emp_no
)
SELECT 
    manager_name, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT reporting_emp_no) AS reporting_employees 
FROM 
    manager_employees 
GROUP BY 
    manager_emp_no, manager_name 
ORDER BY 
    reporting_employees DESC, 
    manager_name ASC, 
    manager_emp_no ASC 
LIMIT 10;
```
